runs.name: profile-1
runs.render_graph_scope: Paired timestamps around RenderGraph Begin through Render and selected-light copy, before diagnostic resolve/submission. GPU includes intervening graph work and gaps, not presentation latency or every upload. CPU is command-encoding wall time, not whole-game CPU or active CPU cycles. Nested scopes overlap; never add their quantiles.
